global_settings.description: Global Icinga 2 settings. log_level is the only globally supported setting in icinga2.conf; other values (log_file, pid_file, enable_remote_commands, ignore_on_weekend) are not valid here — they belong to the Icinga daemon CLI or are feature-specific.

endpoints.description: List of Endpoint objects (nodes in the cluster). Each endpoint defines a node's identity and network address.

zones.description: List of Zone objects defining cluster topology. Zones group endpoints hierarchically.

global_zones.description: Global zones (e.g., for templates, global hosts). Keys are zone names; values define `is_global` flag and optional `endpoints`.
